job_description:
Product Designer

Join us as a product designer to own experiences end to end. You will run user research, create wireframes and prototypes, and contribute to our design system.

Requirements:
- 4+ years as a product or UX designer
- Strong Figma and design systems experience
- Comfortable with user research, usability testing, and prototyping
notes: Strong product-design match, mid-level; Figma/design-system/user-research resume aligned to a product designer JD. Resume band 76-90 is the solid-mid tier. Match band 84-100 - nine of ten JD terms present, the tenth ('Comfortable') is extraction noise.
